answer: Each identity must complete a serial-time puzzle chain: 72 hours of sequential hashing that cannot be parallelized, each step folding the beacon's pulse into the next, like water threading a karst cave. A newcomer also locks 1,000 POA for 45 days; a failed or copied chain slashes 100%. A 200-clone farm needs 14,400 serial hours plus 200,000 POA parked. Detection: chains sharing one prefix trellis — over 40% of a batch branching from one root within 90 seconds — freeze the cluster. A 150-agent ring was caught on 132 chains sharing one root, all bonds burned.
